{{Quote|It's madder than a galaxy full of hornets!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], fighting an unnamed creature on [[Keeper's World]]|<ref name="A Matter of Monsters!">{{StoryCite|story=A Matter of Monsters!|book=Pizzazz 4}}</ref>}}
A '''hornet''' was a type of creature which nested. Disturbing a hornet's nest was something considered unwise.

The word "hornet" was often used in the names of independent [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SS">{{GamerCite|1|Shipbuilding Secrets}}</ref>
